acceptanceCriteria: The work rebind existing-adoption refusal prints fixed text plus at most the bounded worksource or Git status reason (the WQO-V0-051 vocabulary), never raw Git stderr.
A test drives rebind with Git stderr containing a C1 or ESC byte and a long payload and asserts neither reaches the output.
work-queue-observation-v0.md states the bound for this line.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 during the #156/#157 review (PR #159). internal/worksource/git.go:212-217 wraps a failed qualified Git acquisition as `qualified Git acquisition failed (<argv>): <err> <stderr>`, keeping up to 64 KiB of Git stderr, and cmd/corvint/work_adopt.go:225 prints it after `corvint work rebind: existing adoption is unqualified:`. Git stderr can carry repository-controlled bytes (paths, config values, terminal escapes). WQO-V0-051 bounds the SOURCE_UNQUALIFIED line to fixed text; this rebind path has no such bound.
title: work rebind: the existing-adoption refusal prints up to 64 KiB of raw Git stderr
